name: IoT-based-Smart-Farming-System-Using-AI
description: AI-Based Smart Farming System: Predicts optimal crops based on environmental data (temperature, humidity, pH, etc.). Offers disease prediction. Integrates IoT for sensor data analysis and irrigation control through Adafruit IO. Empowering farmers with data-driven insights for sustainable agriculture.

paragraphs: Agriculture faces challenges in optimizing crop selection and managing plant diseases. Our project addresses these issues by using AI to recommend suitable crops based on environmental data. Additionally, it provides plant disease prediction and aims to integrate IoT for improved sensor data analysis and irrigation control, enhancing the efficiency and sustainability of farming practices.
features: 1. Crop recommendation based on environmental factors. 2. Plant disease prediction (scabs percentage). 3. User-friendly web application interface. 4. Future-ready for IoT sensor integration. 5. Cloud-based sensor data…
